title: Auto Loans: Vehicle, Credit Grade and Term Eligibility by Product
content:
For each Auto Loans product, this reference lists how old and how far-driven a vehicle may be, which powertrains qualify, which credit grades underwriting can approve, and which loan terms are on offer.

## Definitions used in the table

- **Oldest vehicle age**: vehicle age is the current calendar year less the vehicle's model year, expressed in whole years; the figure shown is the oldest age that still qualifies.
- **Highest odometer reading**: the most miles a vehicle may show at the time of application.
- **Powertrains**: "any" means no powertrain restriction applies to that product.
- **Credit grades**: the grades, on the bank's A to D scale, that underwriting is permitted to approve on that product.
- **Terms**: the loan lengths available, in months.

## Product comparison

| Loan product | Oldest vehicle age (years) | Highest odometer reading (miles) | Powertrains | Credit grades | Terms (months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 10 | 125000 | any | A, B, C, D | 36, 48, 60, 72 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 6 | 75000 | any | A, B, C | 36, 48, 60, 72 |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 10 | 125000 | any | A, B, C | 36, 48, 60, 72 |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 5 | 75000 | any | A, B, C | 36, 48, 60 |
| New Vehicle Loan | 1 | 5000 | any | A, B, C, D | 36, 48, 60, 72, 84 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 1 | 5000 | battery electric, plug-in hybrid, hybrid | A, B, C, D | 36, 48, 60, 72, 84 |

## Reading the table

Only the Green Vehicle Loan narrows the powertrain; a conventional petrol or diesel vehicle cannot be financed under it. The 84-month term exists solely on the New Vehicle Loan and the Green Vehicle Loan, and the Lease Buyout Loan stops at 60 months. Grade D is approvable only on the Used, New and Green products.

## Worked age check (hypothetical dates)

Take an application made during calendar year 2031. A vehicle of model year 2021 has an age of 10, which equals the oldest age for the Used Vehicle Loan and the Auto Refinance Loan and therefore still qualifies for them. A vehicle of model year 2020 has an age of 11 and falls outside both. Under the New Vehicle Loan, whose oldest age is 1, a model-year 2030 vehicle qualifies in 2031 while a model-year 2029 vehicle does not. The years are chosen purely for illustration.
